Unpaid registrations will not be accepted and registration fees will not be transferred across competitions. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Want to know when the next competition is? Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### No Food or Drink Appleby College does **not** allow food or drink inside the gymnasium. Please consume any food or drink outside the gymnasium or off-site. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.
